title: E6 lane guard assumes an auto-follow write that the app skips while the QoS manual editor is open
detail: With the editor open on an auto pipe ({0,100,0}), the guard validates against qos_auto_weights_after (e.g. {70,30,0}) but set_lane_class suppresses the auto-follow, so a never-drop class lands on a lane whose settled weight is 0 — the exact state E6 exists to reject (floor backstops at 1 unit). Pre-change impossible: the balanced default was all-positive. Unreachable with MVP data (packet_types.json max_loss_pct 30/10, no never-drop class) — latent for future content.
recommended_fix: In validate_set_lane, only use qos_auto_weights_after when the auto-follow will actually run (or run the follow regardless of qos_editing); otherwise guard against current weights.

title: assigned flag never returns to false: reverting all lanes to Standard keeps the never-drop fold engaged
detail: Once any Set_Lane lands, the override entry persists even when reverted to Standard, so `assigned` stays true and the never-drop fold keeps engaging. With a future never-drop class defaulting off Standard, a fully-reverted pipe yields {70,30,0}, not the AC's {0,100,0}. MVP unaffected (all default_lane pinned to Standard).
recommended_fix: When Set_Lane sets a class to its catalog default_lane, delete the override entry instead of storing it, so revert-all restores the true untouched state.

title: Three stale 'default preset' comments survive the fix — the documented-as-canon drift class this PR retires
evidence: data/balance.json _comment (post-edit) still contains: "default_lane_preset is the resting position every pipe starts on + the E5 all-zero fallback." core/topology.odin:35: "pipe_weights: [dynamic][3]i32,  // per-pipe lane WFQ weights (parallel to pipes); default = the catalog default preset at draw". core/serialize.odin:332: "// Only pipes whose weights differ from the catalog default preset serialize".
detail: The PR's root cause was a balance.json comment documenting the drift as canon; the same comment's default_lane_preset clause (and two code comments) still describe the balanced preset as the pipe resting default, contradicting the 08-19 ruling applied everywhere else.
recommended_fix: Update the three comments to name qos_unconfigured_weights (100% Standard ladder row) as the resting/sparse default; keep default_lane_preset described as app-side quick-set only.
